title: Is 5G Spelling Our DOOM?! How EM Waves Can Hurt
summary: ElectroBOOM examines whether 5G and other electromagnetic waves can harm people, explaining the EM spectrum and the difference between ionizing and non-ionizing radiation. It includes experiments and measurements in his usual humorous style.
why: HN links it as an entertaining, in-depth rebuttal to 5G health fears from an electrical engineer.

quote.text: ElectroBoom has a great video that goes in depth about the electromagnetic spectrum
